title: Michael Talbot dies of the leukemia he wrote about in his vampire novel

tellings.quote: I visited him at the hospital before his death. And the irony of Michael Talbot's death is is that he had written a novel about a vampire novel in which he claimed that vampireism was a rare form of leukemia and then he contracted a rare form of leukemia that killed him.

plain: The writer Michael Talbot, author of the book The Holographic Universe, had once written a vampire novel in which vampirism was a rare form of leukemia, a blood cancer. Then, in 1992, he died of a rare form of leukemia himself. This comes from Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher with a doctorate who studies psychic claims and who says he visited Talbot in hospital before he died, and who tells it as a strange irony, as if the novel had foreseen its author's death.
